t: Four words after counting to ten five times
a: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَعَافِنِي أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ ضِيقِ الْمَقَامِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
p: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-hdinī wa-rzuqnī wa ʿāfinī. Aʿūdhu bi-Llāhi min ḍīqi-l-maqāmi yawma-l-qiyāmah
m: O Allah, forgive me, guide me, provide for me, and keep me well. I seek refuge in Allah from the narrowness of the standing on the Day of Resurrection.
